observations: Energy selection minimizes the declared uniform L2 tail bound for fixed K.
At K=3, energy selection certifies 10319 channels versus 5269 for most-negative selection.
At K=3, energy selection certifies about 65.18 percent of the 15833 prime-positive channels in the tested range.
Most-negative channel contributions are not optimal under the uniform L2 tail bound because they can leave high-energy frequencies in the tail.
All certificates are sufficient only; failure to certify does not imply absence of a prime-prime representation.
